universal_format.description: Every entry is a head-rigged gltf+bin attachment (rigged to a Head bone in its own skeleton). To use on a character: re-target the rig to that character's Head bone (skeleton retarget, no remodeling). 4 shared hair textures serve all entries.

variants_rule: New hair variants = new entries + new files. Nothing here is overwritten.
